table.retrieve:
SELECT
	servicerinvcode = dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode,
	serviceinvcode = dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvcode, 
	date = dbo.servicerheader.date, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.servicerheader.discperc, 
	flatdisc = dbo.servicerheader.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.servicerheader.misccharges, 
	servicediscperc = dbo.servicerdetail.discperc, 
	doctype = Case dbo.servicerheader.servicercatcode When 15 Then 'Cash' When 14 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	qty = dbo.servicerdetail.qty, 
	price = dbo.servicerdetail.serviceprice, 
	serviceflatdisc= dbo.servicerdetail.serviceflatdisc, 
	salesperson = dbo.salesman.name, 
	servicename = service.name, 
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, servicerheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, servicerheader.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, servicerheader.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	serviceinvgstperc = dbo.servicerheader.serviceinvgstperc,
	ServiceFlatTax=dbo.servicerdetail.ServiceFlatTax,
	ServiceGstperc=dbo.servicerdetail.ServiceGstperc,
	rowid=dbo.servicerdetail.srvrrowid
FROM 	 
	dbo.servicerheader, 
	dbo.servicerdetail
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.salesman ON (dbo.servicerdetail.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode),
	dbo.service, 
	dbo.accounts
	
WHERE  
	dbo.servicerheader.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.servicerheader.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = dbo.servicerdetail.servicerinvcode and  
	dbo.servicerdetail.servicecode = service.servicecode and 
	dbo.servicerheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  servicerinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  misccharges for all Distinct   servicerinvcode  )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.visible: 1	IF( sum( c_tottax for all Distinct   servicerinvcode  )  = 0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: sum( c_tottax for all Distinct   servicerinvcode  )

objects.name: t_8
objects.visible: 1	IF(sum( c_tottax for all Distinct   servicerinvcode  ) = 0, 0, 1)

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_amount for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   servicerinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for all distinct   servicerinvcode ), 0) + sum( c_tottax for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression:
Round ( Sum(( qty * price  )  *  ( 1 -  ( servicediscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges   , 0) + Round(Round(Sum(qty * (price - serviceflatdisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * 0.01 * servicegstPerc for group 2), 2) + Sum(qty * serviceflattax for group 2) +
Round(Sum(qty * (price - ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) - flatdisc for group 2) * 0.01* serviceinvgstperc, 2), 0)

objects.name: c_tottax
objects.expression:
Round(Round(Sum(qty * (price - serviceflatdisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * 0.01 * servicegstPerc for group 2), 2) + Sum(qty * serviceflattax for group 2) +
Round(Sum(qty * (price - ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - servicediscperc * 0.01) * (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) - flatdisc for group 2) * 0.01* serviceinvgstperc, 2), 0)
